description:
There is a LOT that can be done to make you more productive by putting in LESS effort, 

so if you want me to continue with this series leave a comment!
transcript: This is how I get more shit done than I ever have in my life by doing less and you're not gonna like it. First I pick a task that'll take me a few hours, this is important, it can't be any old quick task. Once I've picked, I work on it until my focus is waning or I need something to eat or there's another task I need to get to and then I do this. And this is the bit you're gonna hate. I take it from here and I move it down here to continue working on it tomorrow. Wait, Sam, that can't be right, that's too simple No, you all-or-nothing motherfucker, it does two simple things. First, it stops me from burning out on the task by hyperfixating for so long that I have no energy for anything else. Second, it makes working on it feel more fun, because instead of this big overwhelming thing, it's this fun little project I'm chipping away at. I can't explain exactly why, but when you try to get a big task done every day, it feels like burnout. But when you try to get a bit of a big project done every day, it feels like progress, and... it's fun. But I'm going this way if you wanna come.
